parameters.description:
The app identifier should be your app's URL and is used as the primary identifier for rankings.
This is used to track API usage per application.
parameters.name: HTTP-Referer

parameters.description: The app display name allows you to customize how your app appears in OpenRouter's dashboard.
parameters.name: X-OpenRouter-Title

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of app categories (e.g. "cli-agent,cloud-agent"). Used for marketplace rankings.
parameters.name: X-OpenRouter-Categories

api_type.description: Type of API used for the generation

app_id.description: ID of the app that made the request

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the generation was created

data_region.description: The data region this generation was routed through. 'europe' for EU-routed requests, 'global' otherwise.

generation_time.description: Time taken for generation in milliseconds

native_finish_reason.description: Native finish reason as reported by provider

native_tokens_cached.description: Native cached tokens as reported by provider

native_tokens_completion.description: Native completion tokens as reported by provider

native_tokens_completion_images.description: Native completion image tokens as reported by provider

native_tokens_prompt.description: Native prompt tokens as reported by provider

native_tokens_reasoning.description: Native reasoning tokens as reported by provider

num_input_audio_prompt.description: Number of audio inputs in the prompt

num_media_completion.description: Number of media items in the completion

num_media_prompt.description: Number of media items in the prompt

preset_id.description: ID of the preset used for this generation, null if no preset was used

provider_name.description: Name of the provider that served the request

provider_responses.description: List of provider responses for this generation, including fallback attempts

items.description: Details of a provider response for a generation attempt

is_byok.description: Whether the request used a bring-your-own-key

routed_service_tier.description: The service tier this request was routed to (e.g. flex, priority). The tier actually applied and billed is determined by the provider response and may differ.

status.description: HTTP status code from the provider

request_id.description: Unique identifier grouping all generations from a single API request

response_cache_source_id.description: If this generation was served from response cache, contains the original generation ID. Null otherwise.

router.description: Router used for the request (e.g., openrouter/auto)

service_tier.description: Service tier the upstream provider reported running this request on, or null if it did not report one.

session_id.description: Session identifier grouping multiple generations in the same session

tokens_completion.description: Number of tokens in the completion

tokens_prompt.description: Number of tokens in the prompt

total_cost.description: Total cost of the generation in USD

upstream_id.description: Upstream provider's identifier for this generation

upstream_inference_cost.description: Cost charged by the upstream provider

web_search_engine.description: The resolved web search engine used for this generation (e.g. exa, firecrawl, parallel)

200.description: Returns the request metadata for this generation
